topic: Adding your kid as an authorized user to build credit fast vs waiting (Gabe vs Isla)

scenes.narration: His mom added him to her twenty two year old card. His score jumped from five hundred eighty to six hundred ninety in one statement cycle. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a doctor's office holding a clipboard with a score chart climbing sharply, comic burst banner reads FIVE EIGHTY TO SIX NINETY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gabe and Isla each have a twenty year old kid with a thin credit file and a starting score around five hundred eighty. Both want to help their kid build credit before college loans.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, left side man gabe sitting at a kitchen table with his college age kid, right side woman isla with her college age kid at a kitchen table, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gabe calls his oldest credit card, asks to add his kid as an authorized user, never gives his kid the physical card, and the kid spends nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man gabe on a phone with a credit card form on his laptop showing ADD AUTHORIZED USER, his kid beside him with a thumbs up, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Isla decides her kid should build credit on his own with a secured card and tells him it will just take a few years.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman isla at a kitchen table handing her kid a paper labeled SECURED CARD APPLICATION, a small calendar behind them showing TWO TO THREE YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thirty days later Gabe's kid checks his score. The twenty two year old card showed up on his report and his score is now six hundred ninety, up one hundred and ten points.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, gabe and his kid celebrating at a kitchen table with a phone showing a credit score chart climbing to SIX NINETY, comic banner reads ONE TEN POINT JUMP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Isla's kid still has a five hundred eighty score after thirty days because his secured card has only one month of history reporting.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side gabe and his kid celebrating, right side isla and her kid looking at a phone with a score chart still at FIVE EIGHTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Add your kid as an authorized user on your oldest, lowest utilization card. They get the full age and history overnight. No physical card needed. Legal, free, and the fastest credit hack there is. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
